summary: Quantify how well structural node degree predicts functional node degree in the zebrafish brain — weighted row sums of the undirected structural connectome versus weighted row sums of the group-average FC matrix, tested with Pearson correlation and a least-squares line, plotted as a scatter with a best-fit line and the r value in the corner.
use_when: Analyze structural degree vs functional degree — correlation and linear fit
Generate structural degree vs functional degree — correlation and linear fit outputs
avoid_when: The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
Connectivity estimates are unsupported because sampling, preprocessing, or matrix alignment is inadequate
